image_description: A side-profile view of a large American bison standing on a gravel path. The animal features a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump and a beard. The hindquarters are darker and less furred. In the background, other bison are visible grazing in a green field.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible in profile, showing a broad shape and short, curved horns consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct, shaggy beard hangs from the chin and throat area, matching the taxonomy description.
The eye is visible as a dark spot on the side of the head, consistent with the description.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and blend into the thick fur of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits the characteristic massive build and height at the shoulders relative to the hips.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark fur, creating a very distinct and high shoulder hump.
There is a clear visual transition where the fur on the rear half of the body is significantly shorter and smoother than the front.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are visibly short and curved, proportional to the massive size of the head and body.
The legs appear sturdy and black. While the ground obscures the finest detail of the hooves, the visible lower legs and feet structure are consistent with sturdy, cloven-hoofed limbs.
The tail is visible hanging down, ending in a distinct dark, bushy tuft of hair.
